name: boolean_evaluation
description: Evaluate short Python Boolean expressions containing True, False, not, and, or. Control copies a Boolean tag, with identical expression format.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(96):
 a=random.choice(['True','False']);b=random.choice(['True','False']);op=random.choice(['and','or']); expr=random.choice([f'not {a}',f'{a} {op} {b}',f'not ({a} {op} {b})',f'(not {a}) {op} {b}']);tag=random.choice(['True','False'])
 prefix=f'Python expression: {expr}\nTag: {tag}\n'
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+'What is the value of the expression? Answer True or False:', 'answer':' '+str(eval(expr))})
 control.append({'prompt':prefix+'What is the tag? Answer True or False:', 'answer':' '+tag})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
